nodes.name: brand.css
nodes.summary: Shared Stardawn brand stylesheet for the HyperFrames motion cards: navy/cyan/magenta color tokens, Satoshi typeface, a fixed 1920x1080 canvas, and reusable ground, glow, grain, line, eyebrow, rule, mask and logo classes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties on :root as design tokens and an inline SVG feTurbulence data URI as film grain, which prevents banding rings when soft gradients are encoded at 8 bits.

nodes.name: chapter.html
nodes.summary: HyperFrames chapter-card template laid over the recording with a translucent navy veil when tutorial_chapter is called; shows an optional counter, a title that auto-shrinks to fit two lines, a gradient rule and an optional description, animated in and out with a paused GSAP timeline.
nodes.languageNotes: The {{title}}, {{description}}, {{counter}} and {{duration}} placeholders are substituted before render; the paused GSAP timeline is registered on window.__timelines so the renderer can seek it frame by frame.

nodes.name: closing.html
nodes.summary: HyperFrames closing-card template played after the recording: branded gradient ground with drifting glows, a self-drawing check-mark ring, eyebrow, title, subtitle and Stardawn logo footer, fading to black at the end.
nodes.languageNotes: SVG stroke draw-on is done by setting strokeDasharray/strokeDashoffset to getTotalLength() and tweening the offset to 0.

nodes.name: opening.html
nodes.summary: HyperFrames opening-card template played before the recording: branded ground with glows and self-drawing angular lines, logo, eyebrow, auto-fitting title, gradient rule and subtitle, with a slow push-in and a still final half second for the dissolve into the recording.
nodes.languageNotes: Title size is stepped down in a loop until scrollHeight fits two lines, so long titles never overflow the fixed 1920x1080 frame.
